title: Assevra: A Reliability Scorecard for LLM Agents
description: Assevra is an MIT-licensed framework for evaluating captured agent runs. Version 0.6 adds explicit release decisions, actionable findings, required coverage, evaluator-error handling, full tool-schema validation, observed final-state assertions, and an executable synthetic refund workflow demonstrating failure, repair, and verification. Dimension pass rates carry sample sizes and Wilson confidence intervals. Portable schema-v2 HTML and JSON reports support optional Ed25519 signing of canonical JSON. Model judging requires user calibration against representative human labels; scans and mock self-tests do not constitute passing release evidence. Integration recipes and trace adapters are provided for common agent frameworks and observability exports.
